## Change and rationale

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Experimental impact

State whether data, splits, preprocessing, seeds, metrics, model revisions or dependencies change. Identify new or superseded run artifacts.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant protocol tests pass.
- [ ] Results are measured and incomplete work is labeled.
- [ ] Historical evidence is preserved; changed protocols are recorded.
- [ ] Tables/figures and Markdown links are updated where relevant.
- [ ] Raw data, credentials and model weights are excluded.

Include commands and evidence paths. Use a gitmoji title with a detailed description.
